recommendations: Do not present the schedule as feasible. Explicitly state that the deterministic validation found an infeasible leg (wwii_memorial to lincoln_memorial) with -2 minutes of slack, meaning the proposed times cannot be met.
Acknowledge the EvidenceBrief's finding that the availability of the remaining original activities has not been verified. Do not assume they are open without evidence.
